description: Schema for extracting glabridin-related enzymatic catalysis and LLPS-regulated biocatalysis records.

instructions: A complete record corresponds to one enzyme or mutant, one substrate, one reaction system, one set of reaction conditions, and one set of results.

Split records when the same enzyme is tested at different temperature, pH, substrate, mutant, LLPS state, or reaction system. Keep multiple products in the same row when they come from the same enzyme-condition product spectrum.
Prefer complete numeric values from tables over partial best-result text when both describe the same condition.
Only extract values explicitly reported in the article. Do not infer, extrapolate, or fill values from general biochemical knowledge.
If a value is described qualitatively without a number, such as complete conversion, enhanced activity, or strong LLPS, return null unless the requested field is textual.
For figure-derived values, return the estimated raw value only when needed and include the phrase estimated from figure in evidence.
Do not confuse reaction temperature with expression, purification, storage, thermal stability, SDS-PAGE, or instrument temperatures.
Do not confuse catalytic reaction time with protein expression time, cell growth time before catalysis, post-sampling analysis time, or storage time.
Do not confuse glabridin with related intermediates such as 4'-O-methylglabridin, 4'-O-methylpreglabridin, vestitol, medicarpin, demethylvestitol, or licoagrocarpin.
Do not confuse conversion, yield, selectivity, titer, concentration, enzyme activity, specific activity, and relative activity. They are different fields.
For in vivo or whole-cell systems, keep intracellular, extracellular, and total production distinct in evidence when the article distinguishes them.
For LLPS systems, distinguish free enzyme activity from condensate, coacervate, droplet, cluster, or scaffold-localized activity.
Return JSON only. Each metric value must be an object with value, unit, and evidence.
If a numeric field is reported as a range or condition series, keep the raw range string and evidence; do not collapse it to a midpoint.
For LLPS-only studies without catalytic output, fill LLPS context fields and return null for glabridin-specific catalytic metrics.
When comparing condensate and soluble controls, create or extract separate records for each state if their conditions or kinetic parameters differ.
Use data_source_type=figure_estimated when a value is read approximately from a plot, and keep the phrase estimated from figure in evidence.

metrics.name: enzyme_name
metrics.description: Enzyme name such as GgOC1, GgDMT1, PTR, PT, IFR, LOX, or peptide/coacervate catalyst.

metrics.name: enzyme_mutant
metrics.description: Mutant or variant name, including site mutation format such as I293A, T295S, N303R, H270A.

metrics.name: enzyme_source_species
metrics.description: Natural source species of the enzyme.

metrics.name: expression_host
metrics.description: Heterologous expression or production host.

metrics.name: substrate_name
metrics.description: Substrate name.

metrics.name: substrate_id
metrics.description: Substrate compound number or article-specific identifier.

metrics.name: main_product_name
metrics.description: Main product name.

metrics.name: main_product_id
metrics.description: Main product compound number or article-specific identifier.

metrics.name: byproduct_name
metrics.description: Side product or shunt product.

metrics.name: reaction_system_type
metrics.description: Reaction system type: purified enzyme, crude enzyme, microsome, whole cell, in vivo fermentation, LLPS condensate, coacervate, droplet, cluster, or peptide catalyst.

metrics.name: is_whole_cell
metrics.description: Whether the reported catalysis is whole-cell or in vivo rather than purified in vitro enzyme.

metrics.name: llps_component
metrics.description: LLPS scaffold, protein, peptide, polymer, RNA, or condensate component.

metrics.name: llps_state
metrics.description: Assembly or phase state, such as free, dispersed, cluster, droplet, condensate, coacervate, phosphorylated, methylated, or scaffold-localized.

metrics.name: llps_trigger
metrics.description: LLPS trigger or regulator, including salt, RNA, phosphorylation, methylation, light activation, scaffold concentration, or polymer additive.

metrics.name: reaction_temperature
metrics.description: Temperature during catalytic reaction or kinetic assay, not expression, purification, storage, or thermal-stability temperature.

metrics.name: reaction_ph
metrics.description: Reaction buffer pH.

metrics.name: reaction_time
metrics.description: Catalytic reaction duration from enzyme-substrate mixing to sampling or termination.

metrics.name: buffer_type
metrics.description: Reaction buffer species.

metrics.name: buffer_concentration
metrics.description: Reaction buffer concentration.

metrics.name: substrate_concentration
metrics.description: Initial substrate concentration in the catalytic reaction.

metrics.name: enzyme_concentration
metrics.description: Purified enzyme, catalyst, peptide, or LLPS enzyme concentration.

metrics.name: enzyme_amount
metrics.description: Mass, volume, units, or loading amount of enzyme or crude enzyme added.

metrics.name: cofactor
metrics.description: Cofactor or coenzyme identity.

metrics.name: cofactor_concentration
metrics.description: Cofactor or coenzyme concentration.

metrics.name: cosubstrate
metrics.description: Co-substrate identity.

metrics.name: cosubstrate_concentration
metrics.description: Co-substrate concentration.

metrics.name: reaction_volume
metrics.description: Final catalytic reaction volume.

metrics.name: cell_density_od600
metrics.description: Cell density for whole-cell or fermentation catalysis.

metrics.name: llps_scaffold_concentration
metrics.description: Concentration of LLPS scaffold, polymer, peptide, protein, RNA, or condensate-organizing component.

metrics.name: llps_salt_concentration
metrics.description: Salt concentration used to regulate phase separation.

metrics.name: substrate_conversion
metrics.description: Explicitly reported substrate conversion percentage. Do not use qualitative complete conversion unless a number is given.

metrics.name: glabridin_yield
metrics.description: Glabridin yield, not titer or concentration.

metrics.name: glabridin_titer
metrics.description: Glabridin production or titer, commonly used for in vivo yeast expression or fermentation.

metrics.name: glabridin_concentration
metrics.description: Glabridin concentration in the reaction mixture, separate from yield and titer.

metrics.name: glabridin_selectivity
metrics.description: Glabridin product selectivity among products.

metrics.name: enzyme_activity
metrics.description: Total enzyme activity or volumetric activity, not normalized by enzyme mass.

metrics.name: specific_activity
metrics.description: Activity normalized by enzyme protein mass.

metrics.name: relative_activity
metrics.description: Mutant or condition activity relative to wild type or control.

metrics.name: kinetic_efficiency
metrics.description: Catalytic efficiency kcat/Km when explicitly reported.

metrics.name: regioselectivity
metrics.description: Regioselectivity for a modification site such as 4'-O vs 7-O.

metrics.name: leakage_ratio
metrics.description: Intermediate leakage or extracellular/intracellular distribution ratio.

metrics.name: phase_regulation_direction
metrics.description: Direction of LLPS or condensate regulation, such as promotes LLPS, inhibits LLPS, dissolves droplets, enhances activity, or suppresses aggregation.

metrics.name: critical_phase_concentration
metrics.description: Critical protein or scaffold concentration for visible phase separation under the stated condition. Keep the condition in evidence.

metrics.name: frap_half_time
metrics.description: FRAP fluorescence recovery half-time for droplets or condensates.

metrics.name: droplet_dissolution_time
metrics.description: Time required for droplet melting or dissolution after a perturbation.

metrics.name: catalytic_efficiency_fold_change
metrics.description: Fold-change in catalytic efficiency caused by LLPS, coacervation, mutation, or another condition relative to the stated control.

metrics.name: kcat
metrics.description: Turnover number kcat when explicitly reported.

metrics.name: km
metrics.description: Michaelis constant Km when explicitly reported.

metrics.name: data_source_type
metrics.description: Where the value came from: text, table, figure, figure_estimated, method, or not_reported.
